result.title: Fyan: A Human--AI Harness with Semantic Auditing for Document-Level Formalization
result.summary: We present FYAN, a human--AI harness for document-level mathematical formalization. Rather than treating theorems in isolation, FYAN coordinates an end-to-end workflow spanning specification, proof planning, logical review, Lean proof construction, knowledge curation, and validation, with support for independent supervision and human guidance. A central component is evidence-grounded semantic auditing, which assesses whether formal statements faithfully preserve their informal specifications. A language model constructs structured evidence over local correspondences, omissions, scope, and logical relations, while a deterministic validator checks this evidence and produces reproducible judgments. When a substantive but admissible deviation is accepted, FYAN requires an explicit proof-transfer obligation connecting the formal statement back to a source-facing interpretation. With the same model (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) in every stage, FYAN proves 86 of 143 FormalTCS theorems under a strict Lean check, against 69 for a general agent harness, and raises the natural-language proof score from 0.501 to 0.851. On ConsistencyCheck, its semantic audit catches more inconsistent statements than a direct LLM judge, both on labels verified against the source (recall 0.777 vs. 0.636) and on the original labels (0.873 vs. 0.820), and localizes each mismatch it reports to a specific hypothesis, conclusion, or scope. FYAN also built ODENumLib, a 9,355-line Lean library for the numerical analysis of ordinary differential equation.

AI.brief_summary: FYAN 提出一套文档级数学形式化的人机协作流程，核心是「证据锚定的语义审计」：由语言模型构造关于局部对应、遗漏、范围与逻辑关系的结构化证据，再由确定性验证器核验，并对被接受的偏差强制要求显式证明迁移义务。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「结构化证据 + 确定性验证 + 偏差需显式归因」的机制可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、latent 内容是否真正被答案使用及贡献分配提供核查线索；且文中的语义审计与形式化判断发生在文本侧，与视觉推理状态的关联需人工判断。
